h: Eishes Chayil Praises the Courage to Keep Shabbos

p: On the night of Shabbos Kodesh, before Kiddush,
for Shabbos is called the Bride, the Queen,
and it is the seventh middah, the middah of Malchus,
which is called "a woman who fears Hashem,"
And all the praises of the woman of valor there
are in the work of the hands:
"and she works willingly with her hands, etc.";
"from the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard, etc.";
"she sets her hands to the distaff,
and her palms hold the spindle";
"she spreads out her palm to the poor,
and stretches out her hands to the needy, etc.";
is through the work of the hands,
"My strength and the might of my hand
and it concludes, "Give her of the fruit of her hands,
and let her deeds praise her in the gates."
Now all the mitzvos of Shabbos
are only by refraining from action,
And even the positive mitzvah of "Remember, etc."
is fulfilled by remembering it verbally
אַךְ בָּזֶה מָצִינוּ (בָּבָא מְצִיעָא צ, ב)
although with this we find (Bava Metzia 90b)
that twisting the lips is considered an act.
most of the mitzvos of Shabbos
so why do we now praise specifically the deed?
this is Yosef and Boaz, etc.;
for this too is called a deed,
when one overcomes the yetzer hara with strength
all the days of the week to labor,
and on Shabbos he leaves all his affairs
it is as if a sin came his way
and he was saved from it,
for which he is given reward
as if he did a mitzvah
And on Shabbos all Yisrael are called
and "the awe of Shabbos is upon an am ha'aretz"
and the meal of Shabbos night,
which is that of Chakal Tapuchin
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (הַקְדָּמָה ה, ב)
as it says in the holy Zohar (Introduction, 5b)
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קיט, ב)
And this is what it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 119b):
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קסג, ב)
as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 163b);
greater than the Kohen and the Levi,
who is the glory of the Avos.
But from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
and Tiferes, which is the body,
is the glory of the Avos,
that runs from end to end.
This is not so from the side of Yisrael:
the main thing is the two arms,
corresponding to which are Kohanim and Levi'im
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א כג, יג)
and as it says (Divrei HaYamim I 23:13),
"And Aharon was set apart, to sanctify him as holy of holies."
And from the side of man,
the main thing is the two arms,
the aspect of love and fear;
and therefore all the praise of the woman of valor
for this is the main thing from the side of man.

p: Further, they said in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 20a):
this is the generation of Moshe";
that is, of him it is said (Shemos 33:17),
"and you have also found grace in My eyes";
and his generation, who ate the mann,
and their clothes grew with them,
and everything was from the side of Hashem Yisbarach;
this is the generation of Yehoshua:
that is, those who entered the land;
although they had fields and vineyards
and they lacked nothing at all.
"A woman who fears Hashem, she shall be praised"
this is the generation of Chizkiyah;
as it says in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 94b):
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֶלֶף גֶּפֶן בְּאֶלֶף כָּסֶף
"even though a thousand vines worth a thousand silver pieces
shall be for thorns and briers" (Yeshayahu 7:23).
this is the generation of Moshe and Yehoshua";
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה חָסֵר לָהֶם כָּל טוּב
that is, they lacked no good
from the side of the kindness of Hashem Yisbarach.
this is the generation of Chizkiyah:
and they only renounced the profit
that they had from fields and vineyards.
"A woman who fears Hashem, she shall be praised"
זֶה דּוֹרוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בְּרַבִּי אִלְעַאי
this is the generation of Rabbi Yehudah b'Rabbi Ilai,
and they toiled in Torah amid hardship.
That is, the main reason Yisrael are called
that even in distress and hardship
every one of Yisrael on Shabbos
leaves his affairs for the honor of Heaven,
as if all his work were done
and the nations laugh at them,
that they rest a seventh of the year,
on the delight of this day;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה אֵיכָה פְּתִיחְתָּא יז)
as it says (Midrash Eichah Rabbah, Pesichta 17):
and all that they toil for
all the days of the week
let them not do work on Shabbos,
so that they become poor, etc."
and in the merit of honoring Shabbos,
on the contrary, they become rich
and through this Yisrael are called
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס רל, א)
as it says in the holy Zohar
Therefore on Shabbos we say the praise,
